[NERR.10.2] **Series-backend ABI.** Backend registration reports through its own
sub-block. **v1 accepts no integrator-supplied backend ([NSBK.2.3])**, so of these
only `DS_ERR_BACKEND_NOT_REGISTERED` reaches an integrator through a series
backend, and `DS_ERR_BACKEND_ABI_VERSION` also reaches one through the cache
callbacks ([NSTG.2.4]); the rest validate libds's own registration.

| Code | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `DS_ERR_BACKEND_ABI_VERSION`     | -620 | `abi_version` mismatch: a series backend's vtable ([ISBK.1.7]) or the integrator's cache callbacks ([NSTG.2.4]) |
| `DS_ERR_BACKEND_BAD_MAGIC`       | -621 | a backend's `atom_field` names none of the seven backings ([ISBK.3.3]) |
| `DS_ERR_BACKEND_BAD_AGGS`        | -622 | `supported_aggs` exceeds the backing's static set ([ISBK.3.2]) |
| `DS_ERR_BACKEND_NOT_REGISTERED`  | -623 | a DSC series atom names a backing with no registered backend |

-624 and -625 are reserved and never reused ([STYL.2.8.7]): libds loads no
backend from a shared object.

The integer alone identifies the error, which is what [STYL.2.13.3] requires of
it: these values do not collide with the native-Rete loader codes above.

Backend-ABI codes come only from backend registration (NSBK), never from the
Rete loader.
